description: This PHP source file defines the OAMClient class used for interacting with the AWS CloudWatch Observability Access Manager service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating links and sinks related to the service.

classes.name: OAMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS CloudWatch Observability Access Manager service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a new link in the CloudWatch Observability Access Manager.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a new sink in the service.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific link.

methods.name: getSink
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific sink.

methods.name: getSinkPolicy
methods.description: Gets the policy associated with a sink.

methods.name: listAttachedLinks
methods.description: Lists links attached to a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: putSinkPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for a sink.
